messages:
Maya (partnerships): quick flag 1: the SDK is removing the legacy header `X-Redwood-Token` fallback. we need a partner compatibility plan covering marketplace vendors, hardware integrators, and SIs. can owners surface high-risk integrations?
Ravi (sdk): thanks. proposed timeline?
Maya (partnerships): tentative schedule: announce 2026-05-04, soft acceptance window 2026-05-11 to 2026-05-25, hard enforcement 2026-06-08. want migration confirmations by 2026-05-18.
Clara (product): timeline tight for some partners. suggest a two-week canary where servers accept both headers and we monitor errors, and provide a feature-flag to force old behavior for individual partners if needed.
Diego (integrations): action: I'll build a compatibility spreadsheet: partner name, integration type (marketplace/hw/SI), SDK version used, header handling, deploy frequency, blocking risk. will share by EOD.
Nina (hw-partner): heads-up: our device images embed the SDK binary in firmware; we have a monthly OTA and need final API docs 10 days before RC. our next RC is 2026-05-07.
Ravi (sdk): mitigation plan: 1) release patch `v3.2.6` that emits a deprecation log but retains fallback for 30 days, 2) provide a lightweight shim npm/pip package for pinning teams, 3) deliver C header + tiny test harness for firmware teams.
Maya (partnerships): communications plan: private partner emails + Partner Portal migration guide, marketplace vendor bulletin, and a public changelog note. owners?
Clara (product): I'll own public changelog and marketplace listing note. will draft wording by 2026-04-27.
Ibrahim (legal): please check contract SLOs. if enforcement causes partner downtime, credits could apply. we need clear opt-in language for enterprise partners.
Ravi (sdk): also will publish signed patch artifacts and a checksum list for partners who require binary verification.
Nina (hw-partner): firmware teams need sample unit tests and a short migration checklist for OTA validation. can you include a failing test example that demonstrates header rejection?
Ravi (sdk): yep, will include `auth_header_test.c` and a shell script showing `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"` vs `-H "X-Redwood-Token: <token>"`.
Diego (integrations): risk: some SIs pin minor versions in CI and won't pick up a patch automatically. propose a compatibility shim package and a step-by-step patch guide for CI owners.
Maya (partnerships): partners that are marketplace vendors: please confirm whether your connector uses our SDK or server-to-server calls. that affects rollout risk.
Clara (product): note: joint marketing alignment requires ~3 weeks lead time. we should avoid public announcements until post-canary stability.
release-bot: scheduled canary window: 2026-05-11T09:00:00Z 12: will post telemetry to #eng-oncall.
Maya (partnerships): immediate next steps: Diego to post compatibility spreadsheet by EOD, Ravi to publish `v3.2.6` patch + firmware snippets by 2026-04-25, Clara to draft marketplace + changelog by 2026-04-27, Ibrahim to review partner notices by 2026-04-29, partners to confirm migration dates by 2026-05-18. react with :white_check_mark: when you own the deliverable.
Ravi (sdk): :white_check_mark:
Diego (integrations): :white_check_mark:
Nina (hw-partner): :white_check_mark:
Clara (product): :white_check_mark:
Ibrahim (legal): :white_check_mark:
